subset_policy: Use frozen N=24 subset only; no new subset selection after seeing hardware results.

unique_pair_count.note: Diagonal kernel entries are expected to be 1 in ideal statevector; hardware measurement plans may omit or verify them explicitly.

selected_backend_policy: Choose among allowed backends with current availability, calibration quality, queue length, and compile_gate_summary_v7b pass=True for ZZ4.

shots_or_precision_policy.policy: Use fixed shots for Sampler regimes; do not alter shots after seeing early hardware kernels.

runtime_budget_envelope: Wave 1 only unless explicit post-Wave-1 decision update approves Wave 2.

Wave 1_minimum_viable_pilot.policy: Run first. These regimes provide the minimum viable kernel-survival evidence.

definitions.H4: Estimator all-zero projector + readout/TREX-style mitigation on sentinel pairs only
definitions.H5: Estimator + TREX + ZNE on sentinel pairs only

Wave 2_optional_after_review.policy: Run only if Wave 1 succeeds and budget/queue conditions justify continuation. H4/H5 are sentinel-only.

sentinel_pair_policy_if_applicable.selection_policy: Sentinel pairs must be selected before seeing hardware results; include representative high/medium/low statevector similarities and both same-class/cross-class pairs.

abort_conditions: security gate fails or token leakage is rediscovered
selected backend no longer passes ZZ4 active-qubit compile gate
Wave 1 produces unusable job metadata or failed executions that prevent kernel reconstruction
any attempt is made to broaden scope to RMA6, classifier superiority, or quantum advantage without a new decision artifact
success_criteria: hardware-vs-statevector off-diagonal Spearman correlation is interpretable and reported
median absolute kernel error / MAE / RMSE are reported
KTA and effective-rank changes relative to statevector are reported
PSD correction magnitude and backend/mitigation metadata are reported
success is framed only as kernel geometry survival, not hardware classification improvement
allowed_claims: ZZ4 kernel geometry survival or degradation under selected IBM backend/regime
RMA_status: DEFER; not part of this operational plan
